conditions.description: Participation is restricted to legal entities established in EU Member States, Iceland, Norway, and the following associated countries: Canada, Israel, Republic of Korea, New Zealand, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom.
Entities controlled by non-eligible countries may be excluded from participation unless adequate guarantees are provided.
Research activities are expected to start at TRL 2 and achieve TRL 5 by the end of the project.
The EU financial contribution per project is fixed at €19,000,000 (minimum and maximum contribution are equal; indicative total call budget is €38,000,000 for two projects).

conditions.assumption_note: Maximum project duration is not explicitly stated in the topic text or call extract. The value of 48 months is recorded in selected_call.json as the standard maximum for large RIA actions under Horizon Europe, with an explicit note to verify against General Annex B. This condition is adopted as assumed pending that verification.

conditions.description: Standard Horizon Europe RIA minimum consortium composition requirements apply. No exceptional admissibility or eligibility conditions are stated for this topic.
conditions.assumption_note: The admissibility_conditions and eligibility_conditions fields in the call slice are both empty. Standard Horizon Europe RIA minimum consortium requirements (minimum 3 legal entities from 3 different EU Member States or associated countries) are assumed to apply per General Annex B of the Work Programme. No topic-specific exception or deviation is stated in the source documents.

conditions.description: Financial support to third parties (FSTP) is permitted under this topic. Maximum FSTP per third party is €300,000 per grant at stage 2 and €2,250,000 per grant at stage 3, with a combined maximum of €2,550,000 total per third party.
Standard Horizon Europe open access obligations apply to all publications and research data generated under this action.
